items.title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
items.author: Yupeng Cao
items.summary: Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or a backtest that uses the future yields a report as convincing as a correct one. items.title: Dull, Dirty, Dangerous? Working Conditions and the Limits of Occupational AI Exposure
items.author: Siyi Yu
items.summary: Automation is often justified as relief from dull, dirty, and dangerous work. I examine how these conditions relate to occupational AI exposure using 21 O*NET items across 754 US occupations.
